The porridge surface looks mounded or filled to a moderate depth of about 4 cm. That gives a volume of roughly 300–350 ml. Cooked oatmeal or porridge weighs about 1 g/ml, so I estimated about 300 g.

The bits of orange look like carrot or a similar addition, but they are minor, so I kept everything as one item.
